name: Modular Advanced Armed Robotic System
def: Armed military ground robot developed by QinetiQ as part of the TALON family, intended to succeed the SWORDS robot on a larger chassis.
facts: Member of the TALON robot family
Intended to replace the armed SWORDS robot
Shares little hardware with SWORDS and TALON because of its larger chassis
